hook: Hollywood has everything to fear from *Artificial Intelligence*
caption:
AI is bringing 1980s action stars back together in a hilarious police lineup, featuring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone, Jean Claude Van Damme, and Chuck Norris.
The AI generated parody recreates the classic lineup scene from The Usual Suspects, adding absurd moments that make the characters feel like they're part of a real movie.
The level of detail shows how AI video is making it easier to create scenes that would once have required actors, sets, and a full production team.
